features.name: checking_status_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of checking account status from worst to best financial standing, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection of checking account quality directly separates creditworthy applicants along a single dimension

features.name: credit_history_risk_score
features.description: Ordinal risk score for credit history from highest risk to lowest risk, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth linear encoding of repayment history quality enables SVM to find clean margin boundaries
features.formula: np.where(credit_history == 'no credits/all paid', 0.25, np.where(credit_history == 'all paid', 0.25, np.where(credit_history == 'delayed previously', 0.5, np.where(credit_history == 'existing paid', 0.75, np.where(credit_history == 'critical/other existing credit', 1.0, 0.5)))))

features.name: log_credit_amount_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed credit amount normalized by training mean and std to reduce skewness for linear models
features.expected_model_benefit: Log normalization compresses heavy tail of credit amounts, improving linear separability for SVM

features.name: duration_normalized
features.description: Loan duration normalized to [0,1] using training min/max range
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized duration provides smooth continuous feature for linear margin optimization

features.name: savings_status_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of savings account status from lowest to highest savings, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Savings level is a strong linear predictor of creditworthiness; smooth encoding aids SVM margin
features.formula: np.where(savings_status == '<100', 0.0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 0.25, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 0.5, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 0.75, np.where(savings_status == 'no known savings', 1.0, 0.25)))))

features.name: employment_stability_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of employment duration from unemployed to long-term employed, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Employment stability linearly correlates with repayment capacity; smooth encoding improves SVM performance

features.name: monthly_burden_ratio
features.description: Estimated monthly payment burden as ratio of credit amount times installment rate to duration, log-scaled
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures affordability stress as a continuous ratio feature useful for linear decision boundaries

features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Age normalized to [0,1] using training min/max, capturing life-stage financial stability
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized age provides smooth continuous feature capturing financial maturity for linear models

features.name: property_collateral_score
features.description: Ordinal score for property magnitude as collateral quality from no property to real estate
features.expected_model_benefit: Collateral quality linearly reduces default risk; smooth encoding supports SVM margin separation
features.formula: np.where(property_magnitude == 'no known property', 0.0, np.where(property_magnitude == 'life insurance', 0.33, np.where(property_magnitude == 'car', 0.67, np.where(property_magnitude == 'real estate', 1.0, 0.33))))

features.name: composite_financial_stability
features.description: Weighted composite of checking status, savings status, employment stability, and credit history scores as overall financial health index
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite score approximates a linear projection of key financial health indicators, directly useful for SVM margin
features.formula: np.clip((0.3 * np.where(checking_status == '<0', 0.0, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 0.33, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 0.67, np.where(checking_status == 'no checking', 1.0, 0.5)))) + 0.25 * np.where(savings_status == '<100', 0.0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 0.25, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 0.5, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 0.75, np.where(savings_status == 'no known savings', 1.0, 0.25))))) + 0.25 * np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0.0, np.where(employment == '<1', 0.25, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 0.5, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 0.75, np.where(employment == '>=7', 1.0, 0.5))))) + 0.2 * np.where(credit_history == 'no credits/all paid', 0.25, np.where(credit_history == 'all paid', 0.25, np.where(credit_history == 'delayed previously', 0.5, np.where(credit_history == 'existing paid', 0.75, np.where(credit_history == 'critical/other existing credit', 1.0, 0.5)))))), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: purpose_risk_judgment
features.description: Semantic risk score for loan purpose based on typical repayment risk: low risk for used car/radio/tv, medium for furniture/education, high risk for new car/business/repairs
features.expected_model_benefit: Purpose-based risk captures domain knowledge about loan use cases that maps to a smooth linear feature for SVM

features.name: overall_creditworthiness_judgment
features.description: Holistic creditworthiness score from 0 to 1 integrating housing stability, other payment plans, other parties involvement, job quality, and foreign worker status as a continuous severity measure
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-formulaic interactions between stability indicators as a smooth composite score for linear SVM margin optimization
